s1.syndrome_frame: Malignant pleural disease with distant metastasis
salient_findings: Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Nodular growth on the mid third of the tongue
Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures
key_facts: 62-year-old nonsmoking man
Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Underwent first-line chemotherapy followed by left pleurectomy
Postsurgical assessment revealed residual microscopic disease
External beam radiotherapy was administered
Disease remained stable until July 2023
Nodular growth appeared on the mid third of the tongue
Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1
Absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1
Negative for methylthioadenosine phosphorylase
Homozygous deletion of CDKN2A gene by fluorescent in-situ hybridization

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Malignant pleural mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunoreactive for calretinin and presence of epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Homozygous deletion of CDKN2A gene and presence of epithelioid cells

shortlist.label: Biphasic malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of epithelioid cells and sarcomatoid components possible in biphasic mesothelioma

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of epithelioid cells and potential for sarcomatoid differentiation

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Epithelioid cells and vascular origin possible, although less likely than mesothelioma

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion, along with immunoreactivity for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, and Wilms tumor protein 1, is consistent with malignant pleural mesothelioma. The disease's stability after treatment and subsequent development of a nodular growth on the tongue, which showed neoplastic cells immunoreactive for calretinin, further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: The patient's tumor showed epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures, which is not typical of desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma

rejected.label: Biphasic malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: There is no mention of a biphasic pattern in the tumor, which is characteristic of biphasic malignant mesothelioma

rejected.label: Sarcomatoid malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: The tumor's epithelioid morphology and immunoreactivity profile do not support a diagnosis of sarcomatoid malignant mesothelioma

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: The patient's tumor did not show the characteristic vascular differentiation of epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
